description: Aspirin was omitted from the discharge medication list despite documented prior use and no contraindications.
evidence_in_history: Current Medication List includes Aspirin 81 mg once daily; Plan in office visits includes continuation of Aspirin.
evidence_in_summary: Discharge Medications do not include Aspirin; noted as unintentionally omitted.
suggested_correction: Include Aspirin 81 mg once daily in discharge medications and document rationale if withheld.

description: INR lab results and timing during hospital admission were inconsistently documented, complicating anticoagulation management.
evidence_in_history: Regular INR monitoring with therapeutic results noted in office visits.
evidence_in_summary: Hospital course notes missing or inconsistent INR documentation during admission; no adjustment to warfarin dosing documented.
suggested_correction: Ensure regular and consistent INR testing documentation during admission; document any dose adjustments or rationale for maintaining current dosing.

description: No documentation on aspirin continuation decision or bleeding risk assessment despite concomitant warfarin and aspirin use.
evidence_in_history: Aspirin and warfarin both used chronically without contraindications.
evidence_in_summary: No documentation regarding aspirin continuation, bleeding risk, or drug interaction assessment during hospitalization.
suggested_correction: Document bleeding risk assessment and rationale for continuing or discontinuing aspirin concomitant with warfarin therapy.

description: Allergy reconciliation during hospitalization was missing despite known penicillin and sulfa drug allergies.
evidence_in_history: Allergy record includes documented penicillin and sulfa allergies.
evidence_in_summary: No allergy reconciliation performed or documented during stay; no screening for cross-reactivity with administered medications.
suggested_correction: Perform and document allergy reconciliation upon admission including evaluation of potential cross-reactivity with administered medications.

description: No cardiology follow-up was scheduled despite ongoing atrial fibrillation symptoms (palpitations, dizziness).
evidence_in_history: Symptoms of mild palpitations and dizziness noted in recent office visits and hospital course.
evidence_in_summary: Discharge summary indicates no cardiology referral or follow-up arranged.
suggested_correction: Schedule cardiology follow-up to evaluate ongoing arrhythmia symptoms and optimize management.

description: Neurology consult was requested but not completed during hospitalization; recent symptoms did not prompt expedited neurology referral.
evidence_in_history: Scheduled neurology follow-up for stroke rehabilitation in 6 months.
evidence_in_summary: Hospital course states neurology consult not completed; no expedited referral despite recent dizziness and palpitations.
suggested_correction: Ensure completion of neurology consult during admission or arrange expedited neurology follow-up for symptom assessment.

description: No formal patient education materials provided regarding anticoagulation risks and benefits at discharge.
evidence_in_history: Plan includes monitoring for bleeding and stroke symptoms but no mention of patient education materials.
evidence_in_summary: Discharge summary explicitly states no formal anticoagulation education materials given.
suggested_correction: Provide and document formal patient education regarding anticoagulation therapy risks, signs of bleeding, and adherence importance.

description: No home health nursing or fall risk assessment arranged despite documented mild orthostatic hypotension and dizziness.
evidence_in_history: Patient reports mild dizziness on standing; orthostatic hypotension documented in vital signs and assessment.
evidence_in_summary: No fall risk assessment or home health support mentioned in discharge plans.
suggested_correction: Arrange fall risk assessment and consider home health nursing support to mitigate risk related to orthostatic symptoms.

description: Potassium level was not specifically repeated during hospitalization despite known atrial fibrillation and use of medications affecting potassium.
evidence_in_history: Potassium levels available in outpatient labs; patient uses lisinopril and other cardiac meds.
evidence_in_summary: Hospital course notes potassium level was not specifically rechecked.
suggested_correction: Repeat and document potassium levels during hospitalization to monitor for electrolyte imbalances affecting arrhythmia risk.
